notes.title: The Voidness Update v1.3 - Bug fixes, Controller Support And Achievements!
notes.notes:
Hey Voidness Explorers! Hope you are all doing well.

I am very excited to bring you a new update with several fixes and improvements based on your feedback. As a solo developer, your support means the world to me. Thank you for being a part of this amazing journey! This game will always hold a special place in my heart, just as all my other games!

Patch v1.3
🛠️ Fixes & Improvements:

[list]
[*] Controller Support: The game now fully supports controllers! 
[*] New Achievements: Added exciting new achievements for players to unlock! Show off your progress and collect them all.
[*] More Bug Fixes: Additional minor fixes to improve game stability and performance.
[*] Enemies are now more deadly and can hear you from further away
[*] Bug Fixes: Addressed various bug issues, including minor glitches and stability improvements.
[*] Spelling Corrections: Fixed spelling mistakes across multiple in-game texts.
[*] Player Collision & Stuck Points: Resolved glitches that caused players to get stuck in specific locations.
[*] Updated the enemies AI for better navigation.
[*] Updated the time till the LIDAR effect disappears. 
[/list]


🎮 Steam Deck Compatibility:

We’ve officially submitted The Voidness for Steam Deck approval! Keep an eye out for more news soon ... hoping to bring the Voidness to your Deck soon!

Thank you all again for your continued support, feedback, and encouragement. As a solo developer, it means a lot to have such an awesome community. Enjoy the update, and don't get lost in the Voidness!

Have a nice day all!

notes.title: Update v1.1 - Bug fixes, Spelling, Crashes and more!
notes.notes:
Hello everybody. I hope you are all doing well!

Just done some little updates and fixed in The Voidness. In the upcoming weeks, will be releasing a bigger update and will try to fix the controller issues and making the game fully compatible with Steamdeck. Stay tuned!

Update v1.1 includes:
- Updated some sounds and audio in the game.
- Updated some bug fixed and issues in the game.
- At certain places a big red box was appearing which was removed.
- Updated the enemies AI for better navigation.
- Updated the particles time when they are removed.
- Some jumpscares have also been updated. 
- Fixed some issues where the game was crashing at certain levels.
- Done some in-game optimizations.

Thank you all for your support, I really appreciate it so much! Hope you all have a great day.
